desc:
A guided shopping quiz for online stores asks a few simple questions and then shows the products that fit the answers. Ecom Swift LLC builds the quiz inside your store, maps every answer to your real catalog and tests each path before launch.

## What is guided shopping?

Guided shopping is a short question flow, usually three to five questions, that leads a shopper to the products that suit their needs. The questions might cover budget, use, style, skin type or room size. The result is a short list with images, prices and links to buy.

It works like a helpful person in a physical shop who asks what you are looking for before pointing to a shelf. Online, most stores offer only a long collection page and a filter menu, which assumes the shopper already knows the terms.

## Why shoppers who are unsure often leave

Choice can be a problem. A store with many similar products makes an unsure shopper do the comparison work alone, and many decide it is not worth the effort. This is common in categories where the buyer lacks expert knowledge, such as skincare, supplements, coffee gear, mattresses or gifts.

A quiz replaces that effort with a few taps. The shopper feels understood, and the store gains information about what the visitor wants, which is useful for merchandising and for your own planning.

## How a quiz affects product discovery and orders

The mechanism is narrowing. Instead of sixty products, the shopper sees a handful chosen for their answers, each with a reason to pick it. Fewer choices usually mean quicker decisions and fewer abandoned visits.

Add to cart from the results page shortens the path further. The quiz also shows which needs are most common among your visitors, which can inform stock and content. How much it helps depends on how well the answers match your range, so we build the map from your real products and test every route, rather than relying on generic logic.

## What a good guided shopping flow includes

- Three to five questions in plain language, not jargon.
- Answers mapped to specific products, collections or tags in your catalog.
- A result that never comes up empty, even for unusual answer combinations.
- Product images, prices and links on the results page.
- Add to cart straight from the results.
- Wording that sounds like your brand, written by a person.
- Styling that matches your theme, fonts and colors.
- A mobile layout where each question fits one screen.
- An optional email step with clear consent.
- A report showing which answers and results get clicked.

## How we build it

We start by studying your catalog and talking through how your best salesperson would guide a customer. From that, we draft the questions and decide which answers lead to which products.

We then build the widget in your store, apply your design and connect each answer to the right items. The testing is thorough: every path on phone and desktop, so no combination ends in a blank screen. Basic gives you one quiz for one category. Standard covers your main categories and adds add to cart plus a speed check. Premium covers many quizzes, a larger catalog map, a consent based email step, a click report and a period of tuning.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Ask only what changes the recommendation.
- Let shoppers go back and change an answer.
- Show a short reason beside each recommended product.
- Keep the catalog map current when products change.
- Look at the click report and refine the questions.

**Avoid:**
- Asking more than a handful of questions.
- Requiring an email address before showing any result.
- Recommending products that are out of stock.
- Using vague answer choices that mean different things to different people.
- Building a quiz for a catalog so small that a collection page works better.

## Who this is for

This fits stores with a wide range in categories that confuse buyers, such as beauty, wellness, home and gifts. It suits a new brand that wants to help first time customers. It also suits owners who answer the same "which one should I buy?" message many times a week.

## What we need from you

Send a list of your products or categories, the questions you hear from customers and any rules you use to recommend items. Tell us your preferred tone.

We work in your own store and never ask for passwords. Access is given as a collaborator or staff user, and you can remove it whenever you want. After you order, we reply with a short checklist and share a private preview before the quiz goes live.
